scoring_justification: Cannot recompute lattice thermal conductivity and ZT from raw artifacts without rerunning the full DFT+ShengBTE pipeline in the verifier; comparing reported results to the paper's values with generous tolerances and required structural checks (monotonicity, physically plausible carrier concentration) is the highest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for lattice thermal conductivity at 300K and 900K, mean phonon group velocities for TA and LA branches, and maximum n-type ZT at 900K with optimal carrier concentration, as reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'High thermoelectric performance of half-Heusler compound BiBaK with intrinsically low lattice thermal conductivity' (doi:10.1088/1361-648X/aba2e7), Sections 3.2 and 3.4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported numbers: κ_l = 1.82 W/mK at 300 K, 0.60 at 900 K; v_TA = 1433 m/s, v_LA = 2374 m/s; n-type ZT_max = 1.9 at 900 K, optimal carrier concentration 4.2e18 cm^-3.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly quoted from the paper's figures and text; they are the exact quantities the task asks to reproduce.

outputs.description: Lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K and 900 K for BiBaK.

TA_mean_m_s.description: Mean group velocity of transverse acoustic branch in m/s

LA_mean_m_s.description: Mean group velocity of longitudinal acoustic branch in m/s

outputs.description: Mean phonon group velocities for the TA and LA branches.

carrier_concentration_cm-3.description: Optimum carrier concentration in cm^{-3} at which ZT_max is achieved

outputs.description: Maximum n-type ZT and optimum carrier concentration at 900 K.

output_contract.notes: All scored artifacts are produced from DFT and Boltzmann transport calculations. The checker compares the reported values to reference values with appropriate tolerances; for ZT, higher values are accepted as better performance.
